source.stem:
A helicopter takes off from the ground and rises vertically. It then hovers at a constant height above the ground.
Which sequence of energy changes takes place during the gain in height?

intelligence.enrichment: The lamp glows when one terminal of the lamp is connected to one terminal of the electric cell and the other terminal of the lamp is connected to the other terminal of the cell, forming a complete electrical circuit. complete conducting path between both cell terminals and both lamp terminals -> current flows -> lamp glows The learner correctly applies this rule: The lamp glows when one terminal of the lamp is connected to one terminal of the electric cell and the other terminal of the lamp is connected to the other terminal of the cell, forming a complete electrical circuit. A lamp will glow whenever any wire touches the cell and the lamp, even without a complete path between both terminals.
